references.text: The first delegation of messengers from Balak to Balaam, marking the beginning of Balak's attempt to get Balaam to curse Israel.
The first elders from Moab and Midjan sent to Balaam, contrasting with the more numerous and honored envoys in verse 15.
Balak's promise of great honor to Balaam through the new messengers, showing why he sent more prominent men.
A similar pattern where a king sends increasingly numerous and distinguished servants to persuade someone, as Balak did with Balaam.
The sending of high-ranking officials as messengers, a diplomatic pattern resembling Balak's strategy.
Sending a delegation to negotiate, a similar diplomatic move to Balak's repeated attempts to persuade Balaam.
